reviewed.title: Core Infection Prevention and Control Practices
reviewed.authority: U.S. Centers for Disease Control and Prevention
reviewed.why_authoritative: Current government guidance for standard precautions, hand hygiene, PPE, respiratory hygiene, environmental cleaning, and safe care practices.

reviewed.title: Isolation Precautions Guideline
reviewed.authority: U.S. Centers for Disease Control and Prevention
reviewed.why_authoritative: Supports the distinction between standard and transmission-based precautions and selection of contact, droplet, or airborne measures. Verify current local policy for implementation.

reviewed.title: National Immunization Program: Policy and Procedures Manual Annexes
reviewed.authority: Department of Health, Republic of the Philippines
reviewed.version_or_date: Department of Health NIP manual annexes
reviewed.why_authoritative: Philippine public-health source for immunization-program reasoning. Schedule-specific items are not authored unless the current version is explicit.

reviewed.title: Nursing Fundamentals
reviewed.authority: Open RN; Wisconsin Technical Colleges System
reviewed.why_authoritative: Open nursing textbook for stable assessment, nursing process, safety, communication, infection prevention, lifespan, and clinical reasoning foundations.

reviewed.title: Pharmacology for Nurses
reviewed.authority: Open RN; Wisconsin Technical Colleges System
reviewed.why_authoritative: Open pharmacology textbook supporting medication classes, administration safety, monitoring, adverse effects, and calculation foundations.

reviewed.title: Enhanced Tables of Specifications for the Subjects in the Nurses Licensure Examination
reviewed.authority: Professional Regulation Commission; Professional Regulatory Board of Nursing
reviewed.why_authoritative: Enhanced nursing TOS reference; BoardPrep does not infer current schedules from this record.

reviewed.title: Nursing Licensure Examination Program, August 2026
reviewed.authority: Professional Regulation Commission; Professional Regulatory Board of Nursing
reviewed.why_authoritative: Current PRC program establishes NP I–V scope, integrated nursing knowledge, nursing process, and program outcomes. Scope source only; it is not treated as a clinical textbook.

reviewed.title: Republic Act No. 9173, Philippine Nursing Act of 2002
reviewed.authority: Republic of the Philippines; Lawphil reproduction
reviewed.why_authoritative: Primary Philippine law for scope, professional responsibility, and nursing practice boundary questions. Regulatory items are conservative and avoid unsupported legal conclusions.

reviewed.title: Basic Emergency Care: Approach to the Acutely Ill and Injured
reviewed.authority: World Health Organization and International Committee of the Red Cross
reviewed.why_authoritative: Supports systematic ABCDE/SAMPLE assessment, stabilization, escalation, and time-critical care reasoning.

reviewed.title: Primary health care and community health guidance
reviewed.why_authoritative: Supports community-oriented primary care, participation, prevention, equity, and population-health reasoning. Periodically updated.

reviewed.title: WHO Recommendations for Prevention and Treatment of Maternal Peripartum Infections
reviewed.why_authoritative: Supports infection-risk assessment, aseptic care, prevention, monitoring, and escalation in maternal and peripartum care.

reviewed.title: Medication Safety in Transitions of Care: Medication Without Harm
reviewed.why_authoritative: Supports medication reconciliation, patient engagement, high-risk transitions, and communication of medication information.

reviewed.title: mhGAP Intervention Guide, Version 2.0
reviewed.why_authoritative: Supports structured assessment, safety, communication, and referral reasoning for common mental-health and crisis presentations.

reviewed.title: WHO Recommendations for Care of the Preterm or Low-Birth-Weight Infant and Postnatal Care
reviewed.why_authoritative: Supports early postnatal/newborn danger-sign recognition, respectful care, feeding support, and escalation; current local protocols must also be checked.
